categoryValidation: all five frozen task categories are required; absent category is inconclusive

developmentPowerProcedure.confirmation: paired history-cluster simulation before freezing held-out sample sizes; pilot variance and simulation unknown
developmentPowerProcedure.individualHelperLimit: normal approximation for one lower-confidence-bound test only; it does not give joint primary-gate or complete decision power

qualityJointGate.confirmation: simulate full paired cluster distribution and every conjunctive gate; at assumed effect exactly .05 the point-threshold pass probability is about one half
qualityJointGate.normalPlanning: union-bound each condition failure at (1-targetPower)/2; take maximum of significance and point-threshold sample sizes and plan floors

developmentPowerProcedure.unit: paired independent-history difference after category/episode/replicate averaging
